The '''2022 Retro League Event 3''' was the third event of the [[2022 Retro League]], played on [[GEMP]] in [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format. [[Charles Hickey]] won; 55 players registered.<ref name="t80296" /><ref name="t80048" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' late May – mid-July 2022
* '''Structure:''' six games of Swiss, one game a week, scored by strength of schedule; 45-minute timers per side<ref name="t80048" /><ref name="t80194" />
* '''Players:''' 55
* '''Winner:''' [[Charles Hickey]]
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Sanders]]<ref name="t80296" />

Charles Hickey went 6-0 and won on strength of schedule over Paul Todd Feldman, also 6-0.<ref name="t80296" />
